name: Leonida Keys

confirmed_by.name: Rockstar Games, Only in Leonida: Leonida Keys

notes: Official region. Tagline 'Gateway to Paradise.' Rockstar: 'The dress code is casual, the bars are loaded.' 'Life in this tropical archipelago isn’t flashy but it’s easy… right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America.' Jason grew up into work in the Keys; Brian's boat yard is here. gtadb currently files the island chain under the community name Key Lento; that island name is not in official Rockstar copy, so it is not used as the official name here. Centroid of 195 Key Lento / Keys landmarks.
